catalogueDoc.summary: nanoGPT is a small, readable codebase for training and finetuning GPT-style language models, and for sampling text from them. It is now deprecated in favour of the author's newer nanochat project.

routes.title: Train a tiny Shakespeare model on CPU and read what it writes
routes.description: Downloads the Shakespeare text, trains a small character-level GPT on the CPU, then prints generated Shakespeare-like samples.

stepsSketch.cmd: pip install torch numpy transformers datasets tiktoken wandb tqdm

routes.title: Make the pretrained GPT-2 continue a prompt of your own
routes.description: Downloads OpenAI's small GPT-2 weights and prints several continuations of a prompt, running on the CPU.

stepsSketch.cmd: pip install torch numpy transformers datasets tiktoken wandb tqdm
python sample.py --init_from=gpt2 --start="What is the answer to life, the universe, and everything?" --num_samples=5 --max_new_tokens=100 --device=cpu --compile=False

routes.title: Time training iterations of the GPT model on the CPU
routes.description: Runs the stripped-down training loop with a reduced model batch and prints how long each iteration takes.

stepsSketch.cmd: pip install torch numpy transformers datasets tiktoken wandb tqdm

routes.title: Finetune GPT-2 on Shakespeare and sample from it
routes.description: Starts from a pretrained GPT-2 checkpoint and finetunes it on the tiny Shakespeare text.
routes.reason: needs a GPU, because the provided config finetunes the largest GPT-2 model, too big for 4 GiB of RAM

routes.title: Reproduce GPT-2 (124M) training on OpenWebText
routes.description: Tokenizes the OpenWebText dataset and trains GPT-2 124M across eight GPUs for days.
routes.reason: needs a multi-GPU node (8 A100 GPUs) and a download of about 54 GB

routes.title: Measure the loss of the OpenAI GPT-2 models on OpenWebText
routes.description: Evaluates the pretrained GPT-2 checkpoints on OpenWebText and prints train and validation loss.
routes.reason: needs the prepared OpenWebText dataset (a large download and tokenization step) and a GPU for the bigger models
